shared_resource_contract.carrier: Cost=Op->N for exactly field,sqrt,angle,trig,compare,read,write,emit; Run carries an actual value plus this ledger.
shared_resource_contract.composition: Run.pure costs zero and Run.bind adds componentwise ledgers. A charged primitive increments one category. Derived equalities and inequalities below refer to this exact producer/model, not all algorithms with the same mathematical output.
shared_resource_contract.storage: StoredMatrix N M is a vector of N stored rows of M real entries, not an arbitrary entry callback. collect materializes counted entries then projected outputs and bills2 reads+2 writes per collected index; nested materialize additionally pays row-level surcharge. replace bills a complete N-row-reference copy.
shared_resource_contract.omissions: Proof checking, ledger bookkeeping, loop-index arithmetic and finite-bit representation/rounding costs are outside this declared extended exact-real model. Input matrices/cores are already stored unless an explicit producer is in scope. Word reads may retrieve row/core references, not dense scalar copies of the referenced object.
shared_resource_contract.mathematical_vs_physical: Real matrix/TT correctness and stored preprocessing costs do not by themselves prove a primitive quantum gate circuit, wire placement, normalized state loader, precision analysis or Clifford+T bound.

reasoning.reconstruction: Use e_f,e_r,e_w for the field/read/write unit counters. One entryPair evaluates four products and one subtraction plus one addition, costing 6e_f. Each of the two subsequent projection collects reads one stored pair and adds the same surcharge, costing M(3e_r+2e_w). Summing all three passes gives M(6e_f+10e_r+6e_w). The value formulas are c*u_j-s*v_j and s*u_j+c*v_j; c,s are already supplied and angle/trigonometric generation is not part of rowPair.
